summary: Iteration 55 — Backend testing of 4 flexible booking workflows (SpotU v2). All 55 tests pass (3 expected skips). Fixed 1 backend bug (payment_mode missing from API response) + 3 test infrastructure issues (service fixture determinism, service state contamination, asyncio deprecation).

critical.issue: payment_mode column was missing from BOOKING_FIELDS SELECT projection — API response never returned payment_mode even though it was stored in DB. FIXED by adding b.payment_mode to BOOKING_FIELDS.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: payment_mode missing from BOOKING_FIELDS in booking_routes.py — this affected all booking API responses. The field was saved to DB but never returned in any GET/POST response.

MINOR: GET /api/services has no ORDER BY clause — service order is non-deterministic across queries. This caused test_booking_workflow.py and test_booking_expiry.py to get a random service (svc_demo003 instead of svc_demo001). Not a production bug but could cause inconsistent behavior.

CODE: service_routes.py _get_service_slots — status filter for hiding active slots includes ('pending', 'accepted', 'awaiting_payment', 'confirmed') but NOT 'requested'. So slots with pending bookings (manual_approval flow) are still visible in /api/services/{id} until the booking is accepted. This is likely intentional design but worth noting.

CODE: expiry_worker.py — FOR UPDATE OF b SKIP LOCKED works correctly for multi-worker safety. The LEFT JOIN on payments means a booking without a payment row would still be processed (payment_id=None, no payment update). This is acceptable since all bookings should have a payment row.

CODE: accept_booking endpoint — idempotence check fires BEFORE the TTL guard. If a booking is already in awaiting_payment (from instant_booking), calling accept returns 200 idempotent even if it's expired. The TTL guard only applies to requested→awaiting_payment transitions. This is correct but worth documenting.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_booking_workflow.py (service_id fixture → /api/services/mine, added ensure_manual_approval_mode autouse fixture, fixed asyncio.get_event_loop() → asyncio.run())

success_rate.backend: 100% (55/55 pass, 3 skipped — no available single slots in DB)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests create bookings dynamically and clean up via cancellation or worker expiry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 55 booking workflow tests pass. Key facts: (1) svc_demo001 is owned by coach@winek.app (user_coach001) — always use /api/services/mine with tok_coach to get it deterministically; (2) payment_mode is now included in all booking API responses; (3) service state is reset to manual_approval+allow_pay_later=True before/after test_booking_workflow.py and test_booking_expiry.py via autouse fixture; (4) 3 tests are expected skips when no available single slots exist in DB; (5) test_booking_workflows_v2.py leaves service in manual_approval+allow_pay_later=True after its restore_manual_no_pay_later() calls; (6) Stripe checkout sessions work via emergent proxy (sk_test_emergent); (7) all 4 booking flows A/B/C/D verified working.

rca_of_issues.root_cause: BOOKING_FIELDS constant in booking_routes.py did not include b.payment_mode in its SELECT projection. The column exists in the bookings table and is written on INSERT, but was never read back via _fetch_booking().
rca_of_issues.fix_applied: Added b.payment_mode to BOOKING_FIELDS — now returned in all booking API responses.

rca_of_issues.bug: Service state contamination: test_booking_workflow.py and test_booking_expiry.py see instant_booking mode from prior test file
rca_of_issues.root_cause: test_booking_workflows_v2.py modifies the service mode (instant_booking/manual_approval) during tests and leaves it in instant_booking after TestPayEndpoint tests. When test_booking_workflow.py and test_booking_expiry.py run next, they inherit this state. Tests that expect status='requested' (manual_approval) get status='awaiting_payment' instead.
rca_of_issues.fix_applied: Added module-level autouse fixture 'ensure_manual_approval_mode' to both test files that resets service to manual_approval+allow_pay_later=True before/after all module tests.

rca_of_issues.bug: Non-deterministic service_id fixture returned svc_demo003 (owned by different coach)
rca_of_issues.root_cause: service_id fixtures used GET /api/services?lat=... which has no ORDER BY — returns services in random order. The first service was sometimes svc_demo003 (not owned by tok_coach=coach@winek.app), causing 403 on accept/refuse operations.
rca_of_issues.fix_applied: Changed service_id fixtures to use GET /api/services/mine with tok_coach — always returns coach's own service (svc_demo001).

rca_of_issues.bug: RuntimeError: no current event loop in TestConcurrency.test_concurrent_requests_same_service
rca_of_issues.root_cause: asyncio.get_event_loop() is deprecated in Python 3.10+ and raises RuntimeError when no event loop exists in the current thread.
